tools.name: search_offers
tools.description: Search offers by price, brand, body style, fuel, drive, provider, term, mileage, fees, power and equipment. All filters combine in one call. Each provider's car appears once, as its first matching offer in the sort order (default price-asc); variant_count tells how many offers it stands for. Returns

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: Get full vehicle, subscription, mileage, fees and availability details of one offer, by the provider and id that search_offers returns. source_url redirects to the provider.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_offers" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search offers by price, brand, fuel, provider, term and power. Returns short summaries and the total number of matches. For the next page, send next_cursor as cursor with the same filters and sort; null means no more pages. On publication_changed, search again without cursor." → after: "Search offers by price, brand, body style, fuel, drive, provider, term, mileage, fees, power and equipment. All filters combine in one call. Each provider's car appears once, as its first matching offer in the sort order (default price-asc); variant_count tells how many offers it stands for. Returns"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
